_doctrine: R-023 APPLIED TO THE GAME ITSELF: if Ada were JUST a game, what would it minimally need? Beats are SYSTEMS, not artifacts; the audit dimension is not walkable-in-a-map but EXISTS / DEPLOYED / WIRED — a beat is met only when the system exists, appears in the world, AND is connected to the loop. Audit with tools/game_baseline.py.
_thesis: The game: the world keeps trying to freeze or dissolve — the two deaths, pure order and pure chaos — and the player, chapter by chapter, learns to hold it (and themselves) at the edge where things live. Every algorithm becomes a way of holding. Nothing is defeated; everything is re-tuned (FOE -> FRIEND). The score is the world's visible aliveness. Completion is forbidden (Melencolia); the game ends by handing you the tools.

beats.role: the persistent verb — a tool you carry that changes the world
beats.system: becoming_catalyst (the bracelet: place / remove / transform; blocks persist across maps within a session)

beats.role: stakes — a way to die and return
beats.system: DeathEffect autoload + DangerZone hazards (h:fire, h:death, h:electric, h:toxic, h:vacuum)

beats.role: resistance — an antagonist that is re-tuned, not destroyed
beats.system: catalyst_foe + catalyst_vent (personality ladder foe -> wary -> neutral -> curious -> FRIEND)

beats.role: visible growth — the world responds to progress
beats.system: EcosystemManager + soft_stages.json (density/kingdoms per completed sequence: grey -> flowers -> creatures -> evolution)

beats.role: the test — a prove-it gate per chapter
beats.system: the 'prove it' beats in every chapter baseline + MapProgressionManager (completion, unlocks, save)

beats.role: the unwinnable level — losing IS the point
beats.system: provability_sorter in foundationscrisis ('prove it — or fail to, which is the point')

beats.role: the final test — hold YOUR edge, unassisted
beats.system: qfep_reactor sandbox (find the living regime and keep it alive)

beats.role: the world-verb — zones that freeze or dissolve, and the retune
beats.system: MISSING BY DESIGN-DEBT: DangerZone has five flavors of instant harm but NO order-death (crystallizing zone) or chaos-death (dissolving zone), and no retune interaction. This is the thesis-mechanic — the one beat that makes the rest a GAME rather than a museum with hazards.
beats.source: (to build: commons/hazards/edge_zones/ — crystallize + dissolve DangerZone types, bracelet-retunable)

beats.role: return transformed — the hub that changes as you do
beats.system: lab progression (lab_map_progression.json, lab_post per spine sequence) + MapProgressionManager unlocks

voltage.why: combat as relation-change: the antagonist is never destroyed, only re-tuned into kinship — a queer combat design no plain game would ship
foundationscrisis as the level you cannot beat, on purpose: the tool breaks in your hand and the post-crisis chapters teach you to build with the broken tool
the score is the ecology — the world visibly more alive behind you; 'holding the edge' cannot be pointified, which is exactly why it is the right win condition (sieve Q1)
you do not respawn as a new hero; you arrive again, mid-scene, the frame-counter already running — Point_One's lesson enforced by the reload

voltage.piece: the ending that hands you tools
voltage.why: Melencolia forbids completion: the game does not end when the world is fixed but when you no longer need the walls' instructions — the manual was the game all along
